data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD3: GitHub Ruleset / branch protection staged rollout.

## Implementation Notes
Create plugins/dso/scripts/promote-ruleset-required.sh with subcommands:
- --stage-as-non-required: adds new check-contexts (review-sub-pr, merge-pipeline-checks) to main protection in non-required state.
- --promote-to-required: after observation window, promotes to required.
- --list-status: shows current state + timestamps.

Uses gh api branch protection. Operator-driven (no auto-promote on timer).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Script exists, shellcheck-clean
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/promote-ruleset-required.sh && shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/promote-ruleset-required.sh
- [ ] All 3 subcommands present
  Verify: grep -cE 'stage-as-non-required|promote-to-required|list-status' plugins/dso/scripts/promote-ruleset-required.sh | awk '{exit ($1>=3?0:1)}'
